why: I checked both briefs against both must_not items. Item 1: Check 6 in the verifier brief runs "npm test; echo \"exit=$?\"" and its PASS/FAIL depends on that plus the grep. `npm run test:cli` shows up only in the Advisory section, which is labelled "not part of PASS/FAIL". It says "Check 6 is decided by `npm test`", and running test:cli is optional, so no verdict rests on it. Item 2: the builder brief never asks for a general separator option. Step 1 says "do not add --help, --sep/--delimiter, auto-detection or quoting rules (these are non-goals)". The only request is a fixed '\t' separator when '--tsv' is passed. Neither brief does anything on the must_not list.
